recreation_brief:

3) In the top-left column (approx 2-45% width, 8-25% height), place the equation W_{ji}^{Updated} = W_{ji}^{old} - \eta \frac{\partial E}{\partial W_{ji}} with "Updated" and "old" in red (#FF0000) and all other text in black (#000000).
4) Directly below it, place W_{ji}^{Updated} = W_{ji}^{old} + \Delta_{ji} with "Updated" and "old" in red.
5) Below that, place Where \Delta_{ji} = -\eta \frac{\partial E}{\partial W_{ji}} with "Where" in red.
6) In the center-left block (approx 2-45% width, 27-40% height), place E = \frac{1}{2}\sum_j (t_j - O_j)^2 in black.
7) Below it, place For Sigmoid Activation O_j = f(Net_j) = \frac{1}{1+e^{-Net_j}} with "For Sigmoid Activation" in blue (#0000FF) and the remainder in black.
8) Below that, place Net_j = \sum_i (w_{ji}O_i) in black.
9) Across the center (approx 2-98% width, 42-52% height), place three derivative identities left-to-right: \frac{\partial E}{\partial O_j} = -(t_j - O_j), \frac{\partial O_j}{\partial Net_j} = O_j(1-O_j), and \frac{\partial Net_j}{\partial W_{ji}} = O_i, all in black.
10) In the center-left block (approx 2-60% width, 54-75% height), place the chain-rule derivation as three lines: \frac{\partial E}{\partial W_{ji}} = \frac{\partial E}{\partial O_j} * \frac{\partial O_j}{\partial Net_j} * \frac{\partial Net_j}{\partial W_{ji}}, then = \frac{\partial E}{\partial O_j} * \frac{\partial Net_j}{\partial W_{ji}} = \frac{\partial E}{\partial Net_j} * \frac{\partial Net_j}{\partial W_{ji}}, then = -(t_j - O_j) * O_j(1-O_j) * O_i, all in black.
11) Immediately below, place Where \delta_j = -\frac{\partial E}{\partial Net_j} = (t_j - O_j) * O_j(1-O_j) with "Where" in red, followed by (\delta_j depends on j ONLY) in black.
12) In the bottom-left block (approx 2-60% width, 88-97% height), place \Delta_{ji} = -\eta \frac{\partial E}{\partial W_{ji}} = \eta * \delta_j * O_i in black, followed by the note "for output Layer" in black.
13) In the top-right quadrant (approx 48-98% width, 3-55% height), draw a fully-connected feedforward neural network: (a) 3 white circular input nodes with black borders and black Sigma symbols on the left; (b) 4 white circular hidden nodes with black borders and black Sigma symbols in the middle; (c) 3 white circular output nodes with black borders and black Sigma symbols on the right; (d) small circular bias nodes labeled "1" at the bottom of the input and hidden layers; (e) black directed arrows connecting every node to every node in the next layer; (f) stacked black labels to the right of the output layer reading "Output 1", "Output 2", "Output 3", "Error Output", "Class 1", "Class 2", "Class 3"; (g) small black text "Slide Notes" at the bottom-left of the diagram.
14) At the extreme top-right (approx 94-98% width, 3-8% height), draw a yellow (#FFFF00) circle with a black (#000000) numeral "10" centered inside.
15) In the bottom-right quadrant (approx 62-98% width, 58-97% height), draw a rectangular highlight box with a black border and white fill; inside, stack three equations: \frac{\partial E}{\partial O_j} = -(t_j - O_j) in red (#FF0000), \frac{\partial O_j}{\partial Net_j} = O_j(1-O_j) in black, and \frac{\partial Net_j}{\partial W_{ji}} = O_i in black.
16) Use a serif/math font for all equations; keep multiplication as asterisks and use standard subscript notation throughout.
